findings.title: Windows scheduled task created
findings.consumer_text: A new scheduled task was created on this computer. Scheduled tasks can automatically run programs or scripts. Check whether this task was expected.
findings.false_positive_note: Windows updates, software installations, maintenance tools, and administrators frequently create legitimate scheduled tasks.
next_steps: Identify the name of the newly created task.
Check which program or script the task executes.
Confirm that the task was created by an authorized user.
findings.analyst_notes: Review Security Event ID 4698. Examine TaskName, TaskContent, and the account responsible for creating the task. Look for suspicious PowerShell commands, encoded scripts, or unexpected executable paths. Correlate with Sysmon process creation events where available.
